title: Submerged slope, pool 30 ft above the crest (D&W fig. 6.27), non-circular search

meta.title: Submerged slope, pool 30 ft above the crest (D&W fig. 6.27), non-circular search
meta.notes: Fully submerged homogeneous slope (c = 100 psf, φ = 20°, γ = 128 pcf) with the pool 30 ft above the crest: the extra water weight and pore pressure cancel. Converted to SI.

source.reference: Duncan & Wright, Soil Strength and Slope Stability, fig. 6.27.
source.derived_from: cSlope verification problem V041a (MIT License), https://github.com/ZilanCiftci/cslope
notes: Duncan, Wright & Brandon (2014, Table 6.4, p. 110): Modified Swedish 2.38 / 2.60 with total forces and 1.62 with effective forces, θ = 21.8°.
cSlope fija options.tolerance = 0.001 (tolerancia del solver) en sus checks; no se importa: ogs usa analysis.tolerance = 1e-05.
Checks de búsqueda no circular del problema V041a de cSlope. El caso lleva el sufijo `-nc` porque `V041a` ya está en `verification/cases` con otros checks y otro modelo (búsqueda circular).
